text:
The Monetary Policy Committee sets monetary policy to meet the 2% inflation target. At its meeting ending on 18 June 2025, the MPC voted by a majority to maintain Bank Rate.

There has been substantial disinflation over the past two years. Underlying growth appears to have remained weak, and the labour market has continued to loosen. Twelve-month CPI inflation increased to 3.4% in May. There remain two-sided risks to inflation. A gradual and careful approach to the further withdrawal of monetary policy restraint remains appropriate.
